name: Intermediation

subjectOf.text: Because of the fees attached to its extra verification layer, the OpenBazaar dispute resolution mechanism creates substantial transaction costs that pure Ethereum based self executing smart contracts avoid.
subjectOf.abstract: Because of these fees, the OpeanBazaar dispute resolution mechanism creates substantial transaction costs that can be avoided by pure Ethereum-based self-executing smart contracts.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Craig Calcaterra, Crypto Transaction Dispute Resolution (2017). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2992962
scope_conditions: Ricardian contracts that attach a notary to every contract

subjectOf.text: The cost structure of centralized micro task systems, which require intermediation, produces significant overpricing that does not benefit the workers themselves.
subjectOf.abstract: First and foremost, the cost structure for micro task work in centralized systems that necessitate intermediation results in significant overpricing without benefiting the micro task workers directly.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Decentralized Mechanical Turk Through Verified Reputation (2018). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3128900

subjectOf.text: Centralized mechanical turk marketplace leaders operate as rent seeking intermediaries that generate numerous inefficiencies in the market and deprive freelance workers of a share in the profits the platforms capture.
subjectOf.abstract: Similarly, centralized mechanical turk marketplace leaders act as rent seeking intermediaries that create numerous inefficiencies in the market.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Decentralized Mechanical Turk Through Verified Reputation (2018). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3128900
scope_conditions: centralized micro task marketplaces including MTurk and Crowdflower

subjectOf.text: A platform creates value not by producing goods itself but by facilitating exchanges between two distinct but interdependent groups, and it then captures profit for its owner-shareholders from the interactions it mediates.
subjectOf.abstract: the platform creates value by facilitating exchanges between two different but interdependent groups
subjectOf.citation: Mark Fenwick, Wulf A. Kaal, Erik P.M. Vermeulen, Why 'Blockchain' Will Disrupt Corporate Organizations (2018). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3227933

subjectOf.text: A transaction engineer is a crucial intermediary who brings together, in a safe environment, parties holding different but mutually compatible interests and expertise.
subjectOf.abstract: In this sense, we can see how lawyers functioned as "transaction engineers," i.e., crucial intermediaries that brought together in a "safe" environment various parties with different but mutually compatible interests and expertise.
subjectOf.citation: Mark Fenwick, Wulf A. Kaal, Erik P.M. Vermeulen, Legal Education in a Digital Age Why 'Coding for Lawyers' Matters (2018). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3227967

subjectOf.text: Lawyers have often failed to perform the function of active transaction engineer and have instead become a hindrance or obstacle to transactions.
subjectOf.abstract: The problem, however, is that lawyers have often failed to perform this function of being active transaction engineers and have become a hindrance or obstacle to transactions.
subjectOf.citation: Mark Fenwick, Wulf A. Kaal, Erik P.M. Vermeulen, Legal Education in a Digital Age Why 'Coding for Lawyers' Matters (2018). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3227967

subjectOf.text: The IEO reinserts an intermediary into token offerings: the exchange screens the offering and the issuer no longer interacts with investors directly, reversing the direct issuer to investor structure of the ICO.
subjectOf.abstract: In an IEO, the cryptocurrency exchange acts as a screening device for token offerings. In an IEO the issuer does no longer interact with investors directly.
subjectOf.citation: Kaal, Digital Asset Market Evolution (2020). SSRN: https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=3606663
scope_conditions: token offerings listed on a cryptocurrency exchange

subjectOf.text: Decentralized cryptocurrency exchanges epitomize market decentralization because they let users interact and trade anonymously in a secure environment without third party intermediation.
subjectOf.abstract: DEX epitomize market decentralization because they allow users to interact and trade anonymously in a secure environment without the need for third party intermediation.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Decentralization and Feedback Effects (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3808852

subjectOf.text: The more digital assets are held by their owners in self-custody, the less likely intermediation by custody service providers becomes, so self-custody is the key driver of decentralization in emerging blockchain networks.
subjectOf.abstract: In other words, the more digital assets are held by their owners in self-custody, the less likely intermediation of custody service providers becomes.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Hayley Howe, Custody of Digital Assets (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3936876
scope_conditions: assumes users are capable of securing their own keys

subjectOf.text: Charitable giving has to be fully transparent and hosted by a group of charity experts who have hands on experience fostering common good outcomes directly, rather than acting as an intermediary or sponsor.
subjectOf.abstract: The basic concept of the CHARITYxDAO derives from the basic insight that charitable giving has to be fully transparent and hosted by a group of charity experts who have hands-on experience in fostering common good outcomes directly – not as an intermediary or sponsor.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, How Decentralized Autonomous Organizations Optimize Charitable Giving (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3981021
